column1: # The parity map of v1.1: each of the 85 keys of today's WinForms view catalog (PaperRoute.Tests/ViewCatalog.vb: 63 dialogs,
# 12 hosted views, 10 stages) and its destination in target-surfaces.tsv, or "removed" with the target map's reason
# (harness design 2.3). Read by Parity/ParityMap.cs; checked by Parity/ParityMapTests.cs, and its key column by
# PaperRoute.Tests/ParityMapKeyTests.vb, which links this file, against the catalog itself.
#   part         dialog, hosted or stage (the catalog's Dialogs, Hosted, Stages)
#   key          as ViewCatalog.vb writes it: a dialog by its Form subclass's name, a hosted view or stage by its name
#   destination  a key of target-surfaces.tsv, or removed
#   map row      the inventory rows (the target map's section 3, 1 to 97) the view shows, separated by commas
#   read from    where the row was read: the catalog line, then the map's inventory row and target-map table
#   reason       may be left out; required for removed: the 5e row and its words
